title: Realistic Tools
description: Png items because my texture pack didnt have cool ones. Not all materials are here, only wood, stone, iron, gold, and diamond
body:
I was playing this like realistic(ish) 32x resource pack and they didn't change the tools and it felt really odd so I just decided to make my own and help anyone else with a similar situation. 

Initially, it was just going to use lazy png's but I had to get more creative with gold and diamond materials.

If there's issues I lowkey can't help because this is the first resource pack I've ever made in my life
